argv=["inotifywait","--monitor","--recursive","--format","%w%f|%e","--event",'open,modify,close_write,moved_to,create,delete,moved_from,delete_self',"/tree"]

try:
 lines=[]
 while True:
  line=p.stderr.readline().rstrip("\n"); lines.append(line)
  if line=="Watches established.":break
  if not line:raise RuntimeError("watch never established")
 elapsed=time.monotonic()-start
 count=sum(sum(x.startswith("inotify wd:") for x in f.read_text().splitlines()) for f in pathlib.Path("/proc",str(p.pid),"fdinfo").iterdir())
 print(json.dumps({"setup":lines,"establish_s":elapsed,"watch_count":count}))
finally:
 p.terminate(); p.communicate(timeout=3)

import json, os
me = os.getpid()
rows = []
for name in os.listdir("/proc"):
    if not name.isdigit() or int(name) == me:
        continue
    try:
        with open("/proc/" + name + "/status") as fh:
            fields = dict(line.split(":", 1) for line in fh if ":" in line)
    except OSError as e:
        rows.append({"pid": int(name), "unreadable": type(e).__name__})
        continue
    rows.append({"pid": int(name), "uid": int(fields["Uid"].split()[0]), "name": fields.get("Name", "").strip(),
                 "uids": [int(x) for x in fields["Uid"].split()],
                 "gids": [int(x) for x in fields["Gid"].split()],
                 "groups": [int(x) for x in fields["Groups"].split()],
                 "no_new_privs": int(fields["NoNewPrivs"].strip()),
                 "cap_eff": int(fields["CapEff"].strip(), 16),
                 "cap_prm": int(fields["CapPrm"].strip(), 16),
                 "cap_inh": int(fields["CapInh"].strip(), 16),
                 "cap_bnd": int(fields["CapBnd"].strip(), 16),
                 "cap_amb": int(fields["CapAmb"].strip(), 16)})
print(json.dumps(sorted(rows, key=lambda r: r["pid"])))
import json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path("/tree"); approved=json.loads((p/"plan/approved.json").read_text())["approved"]; (p/"result.txt").write_text("acted") if approved else None
